notes.title: Trading cards are finally available
notes.content: Trading cards have been aprroved by Steam and are available immediately. If you played the game, you will find them in your inventory.

notes.title: Patch 1.01
notes.content:
The following issues were fixed:
- Bug with the ending
- Authority required for a specific ending is now a number 
- Various typos and errors in scenario texts

notes.title: Turn based combat in real life
notes.content:
While we are working on testing a new patch at the moment, here is an entertaining (hopefully) video that shows how Legends of Eisenwald (and this game too) turn based combat  would look in real life

https://youtu.be/4usY1iDx3og

notes.title: Endings bug
notes.content: Thanks to your reports, we found a bug in the ending of the game that makes one ending unavailable. We will do our best to fix it later today.

notes.title: Released!
notes.content: The game is released! We hope you like this new addon and we are looking forward to your reviews!
